verdict.rationale: Kong ships an official CLI, kongctl, documented at developer.konghq.com/kongctl. It supports declarative resources-as-code and imperative commands for one-off operations and inspection, and it has an AI Gateway conversion extension. Docs about proxying third-party AI CLIs were not credited, since they describe a different capability. Missing for 10: evidence of AI-native or agent-oriented CLI features (e.g. machine-readable output, agent workflows), broader command-reference depth, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: It supports two modes of operation: declarative configuration for managing resources as code, and imperative commands for one-off operations and inspection.
walks you through migrating an existing configuration using the kongctl AI Gateway conversion extension
